name: NecRomancer
source:
A court wizard who hates upper-class social events raises their own dance partner for the ball they’re forced to attend, uses the six weeks leading up to the event to get to know them better, and then whatever happens happens.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/rukaprojects/status/1349946937252798465]Twitter[/url]]
